# Move list

Specials and
ultimates have official names, and so does each jab chain; the other
normals are named by their input (forward tilt, forward air, down smash,
pummel, up throw). A normal's
"inspired by" note is a design reference, not a name. An ultimate is
Attack + Special together at a full ultimate meter (docs/design/ultimates.md), unless
the match's Ultimates rule is off. Ground movement is in Melee units a frame,
inside Melee's roster spread (makgora:docs/gameplay-design.md,
"Ground states and the stick map").

## Illidan

| Input | Name | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Neutral special | Eye Beam | His eyes burn fel green, then fire a fast beam that makes the target flinch; short hop and fast fall to fire it low. |
| Side special | Fel Rush | A quick fel dash, Falco's Phantasm, through anyone in your path; press special again to stop short, and a stopped rush still strikes. It sends a grounded foe low and spikes an airborne one, and a hit earns one more rush you aim with the stick. A rush that ends in the air leaves you helpless, the aimed one always. |
| Up special | Wing Ascent (Backflip, Wing Dive) | Spread his wings, then launch the way you hold, straight up by default; change direction partway up and he flips back and dives that way on his own. Keep the stick where it was, or let it go, and he climbs on. |
| Down special | Immolate | A frame-one burst of flame around him that pops foes upward and burns their mana; jump out of it from frame 4. On the ground he slides on the speed he had, slowing only by traction, and in the air it holds him in place. Hold the stick away as you press it, or on any later frame, to turn around without restarting it. |
| Jab, repeated | Warglaive Flurry | Three quick glaive cuts on repeated jabs; the third launches. |
| Edge-guard tool | Down air | Read offstage, it kills this fighter's own predictable recovery at 40% (recorded in edgeGuard.tests.ts). |
| Ultimate | Metamorphosis | Fel fire burns around him as he becomes a demon: a burst launches nearby foes, then he moves faster for 8 seconds. |

Ground movement: walk 1.55, initial dash 1.90, run 1.85; run from dash frame 14.

Normals, inspired by:

- Down smash: Falco's down smash, the splits, with the fel fire of the Flames of Azzinoth on contact
- Forward smash: Falco's forward smash, a stepping kick, thrown as a spinning roundhouse
- Forward tilt: Shear, from the Black Temple encounter
- Forward air: His twin warglaives crossing
